Bulletin No: 01 LRW/26/05/13/01
COLOR: Red
Warning for Heavy Rain
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 09.30 a.m. on 13 May 2026 valid for the period until 08.30 a.m. 14 May 2026
For Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western provinces Galle and
Matara districts.
Take action!
The prevailing Showery conditions are
expected to continue further due to the
low-pressure area in the vicinity of Sri
Lanka.
Very heavy showers above 150mm are
likely at some places in Western,
Sabaragamuwa, Central and North-
western provinces and in Galle and
Matara districts.
Heavy showers about 100 mm are likely
at some places elsewhere of the island.
Therefore, general public is advised to
take adequate precautions to minimize
damages caused by heavy rain, strong
winds and lightning during
thundershowers.
